hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is recovered as O_i[F]: G0002 = F(t)|_{t=x}, G0003 = F(t)|_{t=y}, G0001 = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: polygamma(0,t) is defined at t=x and t=y
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: Structural divided-difference family: F(t)=polygamma(0,t) is the latent univariate function; the members are point evaluations and the first-order divided difference, so the three non-identical expressions share one latent object.
